title: Tangram Tales
shareTitle: Tangram Tales — Seven Shapes, Endless Stories
description: Build a fox, fish, and bird from seven tactile paper tangram pieces, then invent an original shape story on an open papercraft stage.
learningGoals: Compose a whole figure from seven geometric parts
Compare shape size, direction, and position
Plan and revise an original spatial arrangement
interactionModel: forgiving drag or tap-tap placement in guided tales; normalized free drag and 45-degree rotation in open play
feedbackModel: Matching paper ghosts glow; correct pieces auto-turn, settle, and speak their color and shape name; completed animals awaken in layered story scenes.
credits: QLOBE Kids contributors; original papercraft art generated with GPT Image 2 and finalized locally. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids.
